notes: 10 of 10 pair(s) have no abstract (meta['abstract']); the abstract-based metrics are null for them.

params.abstract_content_overlap: share of the abstract's distinct nouns, proper nouns, verbs and numbers (spaCy POS, standing in for ScispaCy) found among the target's words; buckets by how many abstracts in this corpus contain the word
params.edit_features: EASSE/tseval features on whole documents: Levenshtein = rapidfuzz fuzz.ratio(source, target)/100 on raw text; additions/deletions over case-preserving profiler word tokens

params.entity_preservation: Cripwell et al. 2024 entity matching: set overlap of lowercased spaCy named entities; precision over target entities, recall over source entities

notes: document_level SummaC uses an offline content-word stand-in (run.stand_ins); it is not the published metric.
qafacteval_precision/recall not computed: QAFactEval is DEFERRED (its package fails to build against the core dependencies); keys are null.
rhetorical_roles uses an offline keyword stand-in (run.stand_ins); it is not the published classifier.
rhetorical_roles uses a classifier trained on biomedical abstracts (PubMed-RCT); it is off-domain for news, Wikipedia and legal text.
m3d_model_based uses offline stand-ins (run.stand_ins): SLE is a sentence-length proxy and coherence a content-word-overlap proxy. These are not the published metrics.
